The unit determined loss etc. The prosecutor says he misused public funds, amount large, over three months not returned. This is classic "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds) i.e., "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds). No, he just misused funds, not receiving bribes. So single crime: 挪用公款.
